title: pm-dispatch: three measured readings — the statesTheSet census, the enqueue instant, and the battery's cap-sized runtime
body:
Fixes #18248
Fixes #18274
Fixes #18283

One folded dispatch of three cards, all on the same cell of the seat's readings
ledger: `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/platform-readings.md`. Each card is
one commit; each row is checkable by its own control word. Three rows are
rewritten in place (a rewrite buys no lines) and one row is added, so the ledger's
ceiling moves 465 to 466 with a single `ruledRaises` record — the SEVENTEENTH —
quoting the standing one-file exception verbatim and untranslated.

## Rows

| card | line | bytes | what the row now says |
|---|---|---|---|
| #18248 | 396 (rewritten) | 92 to 117 | the ledger's `mustName` declares `statesTheSet`, so it must equal the required-context registry exactly, and a registry row enrolled without following this table is red |
| #18248 | 397 (rewritten) | 71 to 108 | a green gate IS the reading that the name list is right; only the COUNT WORD stays unpinned prose, hand-followed |
| #18274 | 58 (added) | 117 | the squash commit's committer date is the enqueue instant and the fast-forward does not move it, so a landing instant is read from `merged_at` or the `merged` event, never from `git log` |
| #18283 | 428 (rewritten) | 117 to 119 | the battery is cap-sized on one box (430 to 450 s) rather than over the cap, the cap belongs to the caller's container, and the detached prescription stands |

Ledger: 465 lines before, 466 after; every row at or under 120 bytes; no issue
number in operative text.

### Why each row moved

**The `mustName` pair.** Both rows were true on the tree they were written
against. The `platform-readings.md` entry of `INSTRUCTION_SURFACES` in
`scripts/check-required-contexts.mjs` now declares `statesTheSet: true` — an
entry that must name the registry EXACTLY, count and membership, with every
literal present verbatim in the ledger's own prose. So the old row's conclusion
("a seventh enrolment cannot redden this surface") is the opposite of what the
gate does. What survives is narrower and is recorded as a residual in that
gate's own header: the numeral that introduces the list is ordinary prose, and
pinning it needs the arbitrary-literal recognition that scan measured as out of
reach. Both halves are proved below rather than argued.

**The enqueue instant.** In a merge-queue repository the queue writes the squash
commit onto its own queue ref at enqueue and later fast-forwards `main` onto the
same object, so the commit's committer date never moves: it is the ENQUEUE
instant. `merged_at`, the `merged` timeline event and `removed_from_merge_queue`
carry the fast-forward instant instead, identical across one merge group. The
card carries the table of eight landings this seat measured, where the gap ran
15 to 26 minutes. The 120-byte line rule does not hold all of that, so the row
carries the mechanism and the prescription; the table stays on the card, which
is this file's convention for provenance.

**The battery row.** Its stated basis — the battery EXCEEDS the container's
600-second foreground cap — is contradicted by five runs on one box: 433.3 s,
432.4 s and 435.7 s from one session, 434.8 s from another, and 450.2 s from
this branch with a second agent running the same battery in a sibling worktree
(1730 cases pass). None was a cap-kill. The basis is conditional, not false, so
the row is re-conditioned rather than deleted: cap-sized, with the cap a
property of the caller's container and the margin a property of how contended it
is — the 432 to 450 spread IS that contention, measured. The prescription is
unchanged, because it is right either way.

## Dedupe, per card

Each subject was grepped on `origin/main` with a lit control word before
anything was written.

| card | subject grep on `origin/main` | lit control | verdict |
|---|---|---|---|
| #18248 | `statesTheSet` 0 hits under `.claude/`; `mustName`, 排他 and 手跟改 hit only the two rows being rewritten | `required checks` lit at :393 | candidates 2 / rewritten in place 2 / landed 0 / already present 0 / refused 0 |
| #18274 | `committer date` 0 hits under `.claude/`; 入队时刻 0 hits; 快进 hits only `dispatch-runbook.md`, in the unrelated sense of fast-forwarding a local checkout | `merged_at` lit at ledger :22 and SKILL.md :489; `git log` lit at ledger :152 :155 :281 | candidates 1 / landed 1 / already present 0 / refused 0 |
| #18283 | `check:pm-dispatch-gates`, 600 and detach hit only the row being rewritten | `tail --pid` lit at `.claude/agents/os-dev.md` :342 and `guard-process-kill.sh` :74 | candidates 1 / rewritten in place 1 / already present 0 / refused 0 |

Nothing was duplicated, and no fact already carried elsewhere was restated.

## Reverse verification

**Control words.** Each touched row greps back exactly once by a word unique to
its new text, and every superseded phrase greps to zero in the file and in the
repository: `statesTheSet` 1, 数量词未钉 1, 贴调用方容器上限 1, 入队时刻 1;
不要求排他 0, 门绿不是本行已对的读数 0, 计数行只能手跟改 0, 逾容器 600 秒前台上限 0.

**Three ablation legs**, each mutating a file on disk with the mutation proved by
an occurrence count and a `git hash-object` reading, each restored by
`git checkout HEAD -- path` under an `EXIT INT TERM` trap and each restore proved
by `git diff HEAD` empty plus a hash equal to the HEAD blob. Direction predicted
before the run in every case.

| leg | mutation | predicted | observed |
|---|---|---|---|
| A — proves :397 | the count word 七个 to 六个, every literal left listed | GREEN (the numeral is not pinned) | `check-required-contexts` exit 0 |
| B — proves :396 | one required literal deleted from the ledger's prose | RED, naming the missing context | exit 1: "platform-readings.md no longer names the required context 'Governed Surface Queue Guard'" |
| C — proves :396 directly | an EIGHTH context enrolled in `REQUIRED_CONTEXTS`, the ledger left unfollowed | RED on the exclusivity half | exit 1: "declares statesTheSet: true, so its mustName must be the required set EXACTLY — it lists 7 name(s) against a registry of 8" |

Restores: leg A and leg B back to blob `d9bd0fd`, leg C back to blob `90f3993`,
each equal to its HEAD blob, with a post-restore control run at exit 0. No test
file and no fixture is left behind.

## Gates

Derived on the changed paths with `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`
(no hand-written path list: the tool took the change set off the merge base) and
reconciled with `--ran`. Exit codes were captured by redirect before any pipe.

| family | verdict |
|---|---|
| `check:pm-skill-ratchet` | green — "platform-readings.md is 466 lines (ceiling 466; headroom 0)"; the cross-file move still balances: +11 against a net source decrease of 20, less 141 lines of ordinary ruled raise |
| `check:required-contexts` | green — "7 required context name(s) pinned across 3 workflow(s); 6 instruction surface(s) scanned" |
| `check:pm-skill-id-lint` | green — "27 file(s) clean" |
| `check:pm-governed-prose` | green — "2 instruction surface(s) name all 5 registered governed surfaces" |
| `check:skill-frame-sync` | green — the one declared copy of the decision frame is coherent |
| `check:nul-bytes` | green; plus a hand scan of both changed files for the other control bytes, zero hits |
| `check:pm-governed-merges` | green |
| `check:pm-dispatch-gates` | ran DETACHED and waited for with `tail --pid`: 450.2 s, "dispatch-gates self-test: 1730 cases pass" |
| the other 30 derived families | green |
| `@objectstack/lint check:doc-formula-expressions` | NOT MEASURED — exit 3, PREREQUISITE NOT MET (it imports the compiled `@objectstack/formula`, which is not built in this worktree); nothing in this diff reaches it |

Reconciliation verdict, verbatim:

```text
✓ dispatch-gates --ran: 39 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 38 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED (⛔ a FLOOR — 1 derived from exit 3; 1 of 39 recorded no exit code).
```

The one family with no exit code is the battery itself: it was started detached,
so its shell status was not captured. Its criterion is the verdict it printed,
which is the reading this repository prescribes over a bare code.

`skip-changeset`: nothing published moves. Both changed paths are outside every
package's `files[]` — one is a `.claude/` reference under the ratcheted PM
surface, the other a `scripts/pm/` gate source.

## Acceptance notes

- Noted, not filed: `scripts/pm/check-dispatch-gates.mjs` :17 and
  `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs` :25 both still open with the pre-memoisation
  clause "on an agent container that makes a full run longer than the container's
  foreground command cap". Neither was touched. The first file's NEXT section
  already carries the corrected basis in the words this PR's row now uses — "The
  battery now fits inside a quiet container's cap with room to spare" and "The cap
  is a property of the CALLER's container and the margin is a property of how
  contended it is" — and it opens by marking the earlier section as written
  against the old battery, so the header states the cap as the container's
  property already and the card's conditional edit does not fire. The sibling
  tool's copy is outside this claim's declared file surface. Carrier: the skills
  seat, which owns both headers and lands this PR.
- The chain head's claim cites comment 5675816113 under `Thread-read:`; that id
  answers 404. The correction comment on the card names 5675921529 as the one
  meant, and that is the comment that was read. Recorded as NOT MEASURED for the
  cited id rather than as an absence of evidence.

## 维护者速读(草稿)

**改了什么** — 派发台账 `platform-readings.md` 的三行按实测改写、一行新增:①
`mustName` 那两行原说本表不排他、加一个必查项不会让门禁变红,而 `statesTheSet`
普查落地后恰恰相反,改写成门禁今天真正做的事,只把「数量词」这半句留作手跟改;②
新增一行:合并队列仓里 squash 提交的 committer date 是**入队时刻**,落地时刻要读
`merged_at` 或 `merged` 事件,不能读 `git log` 的日期;③ 那条说 `check:pm-dispatch-gates`
**超**容器 600 秒上限的行,五次实测都在上限之内(432–450 秒),改写成「贴上限、上限
归调用方容器」,detach 的处方原样保留。台账上限 465 → 466,一行一条记账。

**为什么改** — 台账是席位下判断的事实表,三条里两条的**依据**已被实测推翻(一条被落
地的门禁推翻,一条被五次计时推翻),留着会让下一个席位按错的理由行动;第三条是缺
口:整个车间今天按 `git log` 日期记落地时刻,系统性早了 15–26 分钟。

**风险与代价(含回滚)** — 纯文本改动,零已发布面,故 `skip-changeset`。风险只有一
个方向:台账行写错会误导席位,故每行都用唯一控制词反查一次、被替换的旧话全仓归零,
并做了三条消融腿(改数量词→绿、删一个必查名→红、加第八个必查项→红)。回滚 = revert
这三个 commit,台账与上限一起回到 465,无迁移、无生成物。

**席位意见** — (留空,待 contract-tier 审查填写)

**你要做的** — 这是 references 层加 `scripts/pm/**`,按分层规则由 skills 席位审查后
自行落地,不需要维护者点击;若你想复核,最值得看的是三条消融腿的方向是否与行文一致。
